votes.quote: Both failures come from a bug in `globToRegex`, not from the tests.

votes.label: reported
votes.quote: the spec says a `/` right after `**` is swallowed by the `**`. The code doesn't do this: at `src/globToRegex.ts:7-9` it turns `**` into `.*` and leaves the next `/` as a required literal.
